_comment: Cau hinh dong san vao bo cai DF Agent - vai tro DUY NHAT: NHAN CAN. Tu 2026-07-31 may in khong con di qua Agent nua (Print Station va Weighing Station deu in bang hop thoai in cua trinh duyet), nen Role co dinh SCALE_ONLY va khong con muc Printer.
_comment_backend: Url phai tro toi CS-SERVER (may chay Laravel + frontend DF). Da kiem chung 2026-08-01: 10.0.60.209:8500 nhan ket noi TCP va tra 401 tren /api/devices/readings (endpoint ton tai, doi xac thuc); dia chi cu 10.0.200.248 KHONG ping/TCP duoc - Agent cai theo cau hinh cu se doc duoc can nhung khong gui duoc so nao len he thong.
_comment_workstation: Id DE TRONG CO CHU Y (tu 2026-08-01): Agent tu sinh ma tram tu TEN MAY, thanh 'WS-SCALE-<TEN-MAY>'. Nho vay cai dung bo MSI nay len bao nhieu may cung duoc, moi may ra mot ma khac nhau, KHONG phai sua tay tung may sau khi cai. Truoc do file nay dong cung 'WS-WEIGH-SCALE' cho moi may nen hai tram can chay cung luc ghi de so can cua nhau. Backend tu tao ban ghi tram cho ma moi ngay o lan day so dau tien (AgentAuth, suy loai tram tu Role), va trinh duyet tren chinh may do tu nhan ra tram cua minh qua /api/workstations/whoami. Chi dien Id tuong minh khi muon ep may nay mang dung mot ma tram co san.

Scale._comment_source: Source=PUTTY_LOG: doc duoi file log PuTTY tai LogFilePath - DUNG CACH HE EXCEL VBA CU VAN CHAY O XUONG (yeu cau nguoi dung 2026-08-01). Doi thanh SERIAL neu muon Agent mo thang cong COM. LUU Y: che do PUTTY_LOG doi hoi PuTTY phai dang chay va da bat Session Logging ghi dung vao D:\scale\putty_log.txt. Agent KHONG tu bat PuTTY; neu PuTTY tat thi man hinh can se bao 'MAT TIN HIEU CAN'.
Scale._comment_nhip: ReadIntervalMs=10 la nhip DOC (bang dung VBA StartFastLoop) - quyet dinh do nhay cua StableFilter: 'on dinh' = 2 lan doc lien tiep giong nhau = 20ms. PushIntervalMs=200 la nhip DAY len backend, moi lan la 1 HTTP request nen day moi la thu dat. Hai nhip nay tach roi tu 2026-08-01; truoc do dung chung PollIntervalMs=500 khien phai danh doi giua do chinh xac va tai mang.
